p2g1.instruction: The Reading Passage has nine paragraphs A-I. Which paragraph contains the following information? Choose the correct letter A-I. NB You may use any letter more than once.

14.prompt: examples of countries where electricity use is greater during the day than at night

15.prompt: a detailed description of an experiment that led to photovoltaics being promoted throughout the country

16.prompt: the negative effects of using conventional means of generating electricity
